whyTheFlags: Without them headless Chrome reports every page but its first as hidden: timers throttle to 1 s and media loading is deferred (a probe read 20 x 100 ms timers at 19.7-20.0 s in the second and third pages, 2.0 s in the first). Phase 7's matrix opened its analysis page early, so its later walk pages ran hidden. qualify.mjs assertReached now fails a record whose page is not visible.
fixtures: fixtures.sh + fixtures-8.sh into the scratchpad, never samples/
method: P-06, as M-02 bounds it: the native control inventory and the keyboard route by the focused accessibility node (Chrome's Accessibility domain), since document.activeElement is the <video> throughout; the route held to the inventory by identity forward and back (phase8.mjs compareStops); play/pause and seek proved apart by their results, and the control's exposed name or value read from the tree around each (4.1.2; whether a change is notified is not observed); each stop on a held frame (0.5 s), three readings apart: 2.4.7 by the ring alone, isolated by an author outline:none on the control's ::-webkit-media-controls pseudo-element with focus and disclosure unchanged (phase8.mjs visibleVerdict), 2.4.13 by area, the area the ring's own pixels at 3:1 (focused with the ring removed by the instrument's author outline:none, against focused; never the whole focused-against-unfocused redraw, which holds the user agent's highlight and any disclosure; where the ring cannot be isolated the area is not established), and, short of it or without it, each exception by its own evidence (the first refuted where the instrument's own author style removed the ring, supported where no author selector reaches an -internal- pseudo-element; the second from the author rules on the control and the host's backdrop, CSS.getMatchedStylesForNode) (appearanceVerdict), 2.4.11 and 2.4.12 by an 8 x 8 hit test for author content over the control (occlusionVerdict); targets (2.5.5) by geometry at rest and, where the box is empty at rest, once disclosed by hovering the nearest control, by hit area (DOM.getNodeForLocation with user-agent shadow trees, document coordinates), and the user agent's size exception only where no author rule sets the control's size (targetVerdict). K-player's Shift+Tab leaves for the previous real stop: the card heading's tabIndex is -1 (src/main.ts:3277).
